dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL (OpenCOBOL) free-format source, part of the Applewood Computers Accounting System (ACAS) IRS module, version 3.02.35. Author V B Coen, converted from COBOL/2 to Open/GNU COBOL starting 2009.
evidence: references to GNU General Public License and Open Cobol
File-Info layout described as 'per GNU v2 manual'

purpose.domain_detail: IRS (Integrated Revenue System / Accounts) module of the Applewood Computers Accounting System (ACAS) — a UK small-business accounting package covering nominal ledger, postings, EOY processing, and system file maintenance.
purpose.summary: This is the main menu control program for the IRS accounting subsystem within ACAS. It handles system initialisation, menu navigation, backup script invocation, and dispatches to subordinate programs (irs010–irs090) for ledger postings, nominal accounts, final accounts, and EOY processing. It also manages the ACAS parameter/system file and environment variable setup.

notable_features: High comment ratio (~42%) with extensive change history dating back to 1982
13 COPY statements for copybooks (envdiv.cob, screenio.cpy, wsmaps03.cob, wscall.cob, wstime.cob, wsfnctn.cob, etc.)
40 CALL statements dispatching to irs010–irs090 and acas* subprograms
OS detection logic (Linux/Windows/OS2/OSX) for backup script selection
verdict.notes: Source truncated to first 16000 chars; full file is ~45KB/1017 lines. Program has a very long change history from 1982 through 2020, indicating mature production software. No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS present. The 'IRS' name refers to an internal accounting/revenue system, not the US tax authority.
